title.zh: 03 | CCP怎么工作：电极和鞘层一起控制放电
title.en: 03 | How CCP works: electrodes and sheaths jointly control the discharge

subtitle.zh: RF频率、自偏压、Electrode Gap与双频耦合
subtitle.en: RF frequency, self-bias, Electrode Gap and dual-frequency coupling

body.en: e⁻ oscillation (driven by the RF electric field)
HF High frequency (typically 13.56 MHz Or higher)

body.zh: LF低频（典型 50-200 kHz）或更低频
body.en: LF Low frequency (typically 50–200 kHz) Or lower frequencies

body.zh: HF/LF功率与频率（幅值、占空比、频率）
body.en: HF / LF power and frequency (amplitude, duty cycle, frequency)

body.zh: 相位/波形/Pulse（相位差、占空比、脉冲形状）
body.en: Phase / waveform / Pulse (phase difference, duty cycle, pulse shape)

body.zh: 压力与气体（压力、流量、配比）
body.en: Pressure and gas (pressure, flow, composition ratio)

body.zh: Gap与电极面积（Electrode Gap、面积比）
body.en: Gap and electrode area (Electrode Gap, area ratio)
What dual frequency aims to achieve

body.zh: HF： 更多影响电子加热与密度
body.en: HF: greater influence on Electron heating and density

body.zh: • 提升电子能量、碰撞频率
body.en: • Increase electron energy and collision frequency

body.zh: • 增加电离/解离 → 提升密度
LF： 更多影响鞘层波形与离子能量
body.en: LF: greater influence on Sheath waveform and ion energy

body.zh: • 调整自偏压幅值与波形

body.en: • Control ion energy and incident flux

body.zh: 是角色分工，不是完全解耦
body.en: Division of roles, not complete decoupling

body.zh: 改变Bias常会同时改变离子能量、密度、解离与表面化学；
body.en: Changing Bias often simultaneously Changes ion energy, density, Dissociation and surface chemistry;

body.zh: 多频增加自由度，也增加耦合和调参复杂度。
body.en: Multiple frequencies add degrees of freedom, But also increase coupling and Parameter-tuning complexity.

body.zh: 边界：现代CCP可采用双频、多频、VHF、脉冲与磁场辅助，不能被简化成“低端低密度”。
body.en: Boundary: modern CCP may use dual / multiple frequencies, VHF, pulsing and magnetic assistance; it cannot be reduced to “low-end, low-density.”
